text:
Maya: AM async — quick standup. pushed kernel priming change to canary (priming-v3). saw p95 spike during warmup for first ~3m, then settles. opening this thread for notes and quick Qs. :wave:

Alex: Which canary exactly? priming-v3 or the older priming branch? PR number?

Maya: priming-v3, PR #762. tiny change to prefetch slot allocation and early KV touch. pattern: p95 110ms -> 220ms for first ~180s, then drops back to ~95ms. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/priming-v3/logs (short snippet below)

Jin: can repro locally if I run two concurrent clients with small batch sizes. looks like slot reassign + KV miss storm.

Sam: On dedicated nodes I can't reproduce — stable. mem climbs ~200MB on canary nodes during warmup though.

Maya: pushed a debug build with extra traces to staging; added a toggle. ci-bot deployed it to canary earlier.

ci-bot: deployed priming-v3-debug (build b-421) to canary at 4839012358.

Alex: @Maya can you gate traces with DEBUG env? don't want high-card logs in prod. I'll review once you open the PR.

Maya: opened PR #789 — trace gated and small unit test added. also starting a KV-eviction bench against canary to isolate eviction vs prefix-cache effects.

Jin: bench quick numbers (local microbench):
```
baseline (no prefix cache): p50=30ms p95=210ms
with prefix cache: p50=28ms p95=90ms
with priming-v3: p50=32ms p95=180ms (warmup window wide)
```
Gist with full runs: https://gist.github.com/jin/kv-priming-bench

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll dig into routing differences between canary and dedicated. suspect quantized kernel fallback or different slot churn.

Maya: blocker: need one reviewer for #789 and confirmation on whether we keep debug traces for one more nightly run. also need Sam to validate dedicated routing config.

Alex: happy to review PR in ~30m. no blockers otherwise.

Jin: I'll run a longer 6-hour warmup tonight and report p95 drift.

Maya: plan for today: finish trace cleanup, run the evict bench on canary, roll canary back if instability persists, file ticket for kernel-routing + eviction tuning (will create after bench).

Sam: I'll check routing rules and quant kernel thresholds; will post any config diffs here.

Maya: thanks — schedule FYI: long-run (stress) tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC. ping if you want to join. :coffee:

Alex: I'll be around for the PR review. good luck!

Maya: thanks team. any quick asks before I start the bench?

Jin: none from me. go for it.
